title: Desert Cyborg Oracle
description: A teal-skinned female cyborg figure stands in a desert landscape, her body merging with flowing mechanical tendrils and glowing orbs. She wears a massive sand-colored hat shaped like a futuristic city, holds a transparent sphere containing a miniature landscape, while a blood-red moon and comet illuminate the dark sky above a ruined cyberpunk city.
prompt: A majestic teal-skinned female cyborg oracle stands in a vast desert with flowing mechanical vines and glowing gears embedded in her body. She wears an enormous city-building hat, holds a glowing orb containing a tiny cityscape in one hand, while other colorful spheres with galaxies and cities orbit her. A giant red blood moon hangs in the dark sky with a comet streaking past, behind her stands a ruined cyberpunk city partially buried in sand dunes, dramatic cinematic lighting, intricate detail.
